answer: Use a proof-of-elapsed-time stake lock. To register, an agent escrows tokens in a vesting contract that releases only after 90 days of clean activity, and its reputation score grows with locked amount times age. Slashing burns the escrow if a challenge jury finds collusion. A lotus of fresh keys, a grove of clones, or a karst maze of shells each need separate locked capital that earns nothing, so an attacker pays about 40 dollars of idle funds per identity.
